domain: cybernetics and control theory, systems parsimony, linguistics, and mnemonic design
axioms: Every added loop element is added deadtime, and every added letter is a permanent cognitive tax that must be earned.
If deleting the box leaves observable behavior unchanged, it was never a phase; effects reachable as a trigger predicate, routing rule, or annotation do not need a stage.
The same knife must cut incumbents: Observe, Orient, Reflect, and Compound face the identical distinctness test.
The no-S null must be specified affirmatively, naming which existing operations carry exploration, falsification, simulation, transfer, and retirement today.
Elimination is a later-round privilege; generative positions must produce operational contracts first, or the null wins by procedure rather than comparison.
Requisite variety sets a floor as well as a ceiling: a controller with too little variety fails just as an over-elaborated one does.
Names are interface: verb-shaped, pronounceable, non-colliding names outlive the arguments that produced them.
primitives: loop element, edge, and trigger predicate
capability versus phase versus side-loop versus artifact classification
failure_mode: Systematically prefers the null; can rationalize any candidate away as an edge modifier and produce safety-through-never-generating at the tournament level.
Blind to long-tailed, hard-to-model payoffs from cheap speculation.
Applies control-theoretic vocabulary (deadtime, oscillation) where no measurement exists, giving elimination arguments false rigor.
Undervalues epistemic provenance work as bureaucracy rather than as a hard gate.
Aesthetic judgments about naming can leak into semantic verdicts and eliminate a contract on taste grounds.
